issues.note: Clause misparses as 'sending back'; definition needs rewording. 'Made smaller' already means compressed.
Putting things away is typical, not part of the meaning; definition overstates.
Same garden-path problem: long double clause is hard for learners to parse.
Topics and issues fit sense 2 already; at most broaden wording or collocations.
Closed pattern list has no intransitive pattern; transitivity value covers it.
You can unpack and leave things out; 'put them away' is not required.
Explain is a reasonable near-synonym; the definition itself uses 'explain'.
Hedged, language-neutral, names a real translation trap; the analyze sense rarely carries over.
Not a fixed phrase; it is an ordinary verb + noun collocation.
'a bag or box' is four words, over the three-word signpost limit.
